name: MedlinePlus Connect
tagline: Patient-friendly health topic and drug info linked from clinical codes
description: MedlinePlus Connect is a free web service from the U.S. National Library of Medicine that returns patient-friendly MedlinePlus health topic and drug information when given clinical codes such as ICD, RxNorm, or LOINC, for use in EHRs and patient portals.

auth.details: No API key or registration required; open government service with URL parameters only

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public service; no published request caps

use_cases: look up patient-friendly explanation for an ICD-10 diagnosis code
get MedlinePlus drug information from an RxNorm code
fetch consumer health content linked to a LOINC lab code
enrich EHR problem list items with lay-language topic summaries
return patient education links for a given clinical code set
